# Good Skill

## Purpose

Converts a thing.

Use when a thing exists.

Do not use when no thing exists.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| thing | yes | stop |

## Workflow

1. Read the thing.

## Decision logic

| Condition | Then |
|---|---|
| thing is large | split it |

## Outputs

A converted thing.

## Failure handling

| Situation | Do this |
|---|---|
| no thing | stop |

## Example

Input: a thing. Output: a converted thing.

## Related skills

None.
